protocols.title: Screen-reader task interoperability
prerequisites: Use a clean profile and a supported product-browser pairing.
Know the normal reading, navigation, forms and interaction commands for the chosen pairing.
Run only against the public synthetic fixture host and reset the booking journey before each review.

pairing_options.scope_note: The result applies only to the recorded JAWS, browser and platform versions.
The result applies only to the recorded NVDA, browser and platform versions.

pairing_options.platform: Record macOS or iOS and its exact version
pairing_options.input_method: VoiceOver commands for the recorded device
pairing_options.scope_note: Desktop and mobile VoiceOver results are distinct and cannot be substituted for each other.
Record device, Android, TalkBack and Chrome versions; do not generalize beyond them.

steps.action: Open the declared journey entry and identify the page title, main heading and task start without visual assistance.
steps.expected_observation: The reviewer can locate the task and distinguish page structure using the chosen pairing.
steps.evidence: Record the announced title and heading order as a transcript or structured note.

steps.action: Complete every declared booking step using only the chosen screen-reader commands.
steps.expected_observation: Controls expose usable names, roles, values, state changes and error or status feedback throughout the task.
steps.evidence: Record each blocker, unexpected announcement and successful state transition by step ID.

steps.action: Repeat the same journey with the matched corrected fixture and compare only within the recorded pairing.
steps.expected_observation: The control is independently evaluated; a result from one pairing is not copied to another.
steps.evidence: Capture separate outcomes for the broken and corrected fixture IDs.

expected_observations: Task completion and barriers are reported per pairing, not as universal product claims.
Announcements, navigation order, state changes and completion are observable in the evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop if navigation leaves the public synthetic host or requests real account, payment or identity data.
Stop if the reviewer loses control of focus, audio or device operation in a way that cannot be safely reset.
Pause on discomfort or fatigue and mark remaining steps not-tested.
evidence_requirements: Pseudonymous reviewer ID and exact pairing versions.
Step-level outcome, observation and evidence digest or public-synthetic note.
Separate result records for each pairing and fixture variant.

protocols.title: Keyboard-only task operation
prerequisites: Use a clean browser profile at the protocol default display settings.
Disconnect or set aside pointing input for the duration of the run.
Reset the fixture to its declared entry and default state.

steps.action: Traverse the task using Tab, Shift+Tab and documented native keys only.
steps.expected_observation: Every required control is reachable in an order that preserves meaning and operation.
steps.evidence: Record the ordered focus stops and any skipped or extra target.

steps.action: Activate, change and dismiss every interactive state using the keyboard.
steps.expected_observation: Activation works without pointer input, focus remains visible and no state traps focus.
steps.evidence: Record key sequence, resulting state and focus destination.

steps.action: Complete the matched corrected task from entry to confirmation.
steps.expected_observation: The control completes without borrowing observations from the broken fixture.
steps.evidence: Record task completion and control-specific observations.

expected_observations: Focus order, visibility, activation and escape behavior are independently observable.
A blocked step is fail or cannot-tell with evidence, never an inferred pass.
stop_conditions: Stop if focus enters a state that cannot be escaped with the documented recovery key.
Stop before any route outside the public synthetic fixture host.
Mark unattempted steps not-tested after a blocking failure.
evidence_requirements: Exact browser, platform, viewport and keyboard layout.
Ordered focus trace and step-level outcome.
Public-synthetic screenshots or notes only.

protocols.title: Switch-access task operation
prerequisites: Configure the recorded switch interface, scan pattern and activation timing before opening the fixture.
Verify the reviewer can pause or exit scanning at any point.
Reset the fixture and switch scan position before each variant.

steps.action: Scan from the entry point to each required task control without direct pointer selection.
steps.expected_observation: Every target enters the scan sequence once in a usable order.
steps.evidence: Record scan order, missed targets and duplicate stops.

steps.action: Activate each control and complete any alternative to dragging or path movement.
steps.expected_observation: All required operations have a switch-operable action that does not depend on fine path input.
steps.evidence: Record activation method and resulting state for every step.

steps.action: Complete the corrected journey using the same switch configuration.
steps.expected_observation: The matched control completes under identical timing and scan settings.
steps.evidence: Record completion, activation count and any abandoned step.

expected_observations: Reachability and activation are reported separately from task completion.
The exact switch configuration is part of the result scope.
stop_conditions: Stop if repeated scanning creates discomfort or the reviewer cannot pause the scan safely.
Stop if a destructive action lacks a public-synthetic reset path.
Mark remaining steps not-tested after the reviewer stops.
evidence_requirements: Switch interface, version, scan mode, timing and input method.
Step-level scan and activation observations.
No biometric, health or participant profile data.

protocols.title: Voice-operation task
prerequisites: Configure the recorded voice-operation product and microphone in a controlled environment.
Use only synthetic commands and fixture data.
Reset the fixture and recognition state before each variant.

steps.action: Identify and activate visible controls by their displayed labels.
steps.expected_observation: Spoken labels resolve to the intended accessible controls without hidden-name mismatch.
steps.evidence: Record command text and the activated target.

steps.action: Enter and correct synthetic field values using voice commands only.
steps.expected_observation: Text entry, correction and form navigation can be completed without another input method.
steps.evidence: Record successful commands, retries and any fallback.

steps.action: Complete the matched corrected journey with the same recognition settings.
steps.expected_observation: The control is evaluated under the identical environment.
steps.evidence: Record step outcomes and completion status.

expected_observations: Label matching, activation, text correction and completion are reported separately.
Recognition retries remain evidence and are not hidden by final completion.
stop_conditions: Stop if the product captures voice input outside the synthetic test session.
Stop on voice strain, discomfort or loss of command control.
Do not record raw audio; retain only consented synthetic command evidence.
evidence_requirements: Product, version, recognition settings, microphone class and ambient condition.
Command-to-target trace using synthetic content.
No voiceprint, identity inference or unrelated audio.

protocols.title: Caption and transcript equivalence review
prerequisites: Use the generated public synthetic media and its declared duration.
Verify playback controls and text tracks load before judging content.
Set playback rate, caption appearance and output volume to recorded values.

steps.action: Play the video with audio output muted and captions enabled.
steps.expected_observation: Dialogue, speaker changes and meaningful sounds are conveyed at usable times.
steps.evidence: Record cue timestamps and any missing, inaccurate or late information.

steps.action: Read the transcript without playing the audio and compare its information with the source script.
steps.expected_observation: The transcript preserves the information and sequence needed to understand the media.
steps.evidence: Record the compared source and transcript digests plus differences.

steps.action: Repeat both checks on the matched corrected fixtures.
steps.expected_observation: Presence and quality are judged separately; a present track is not automatically a pass.
steps.evidence: Record separate outcomes for each fixture and review dimension.

expected_observations: Track presence, accuracy, timing, speaker identification and sound information are distinct observations.
Quality that cannot be settled from the available evidence is cannot-tell.
stop_conditions: Stop if media is not the generated public synthetic asset or its digest is unknown.
Stop if playback unexpectedly produces unsafe volume or motion.
Mark unavailable content not-tested rather than treating silence as pass.
evidence_requirements: Media and text-track digests, playback rate and caption settings.
Timestamped observation per quality dimension.
No external media, personal recordings or production captures.

protocols.title: Zoom and display-adaptation review
prerequisites: Start from the recorded viewport, zoom, text size, orientation and display preferences.
Use a clean browser profile with extension effects recorded or disabled.
Reset the fixture between display conditions.

steps.action: Apply the declared zoom and text-spacing condition and complete the fixture task.
steps.expected_observation: Content remains available, readable and operable without loss or two-dimensional page scrolling where prohibited.
steps.evidence: Record viewport, scale, spacing values and any clipped or overlapping target.

steps.action: Enable the declared high-contrast or forced-color condition and inspect required states.
steps.expected_observation: Information, focus and control boundaries remain distinguishable without relying on author colors alone.
steps.evidence: Record condition, state and public-synthetic screenshot digest.

steps.action: Change to each declared orientation and repeat the critical operation.
steps.expected_observation: The task remains operable unless a documented essential exception applies.
steps.evidence: Record orientation, exception rationale and outcome.

expected_observations: Each display condition has its own outcome; one condition cannot stand in for another.
Clipping, overlap, reflow, focus and state visibility are recorded separately.
stop_conditions: Stop if rapid visual change or motion appears unexpectedly; restore the safe default.
Stop when required content cannot be reached and record the blocking state.
Mark any condition not applied as not-tested.
evidence_requirements: Viewport, scale, spacing, contrast preference, orientation and platform settings.
Condition-specific observations and evidence digests.
Essential-exception rationale when used.

protocols.title: Comprehension and task-guidance review
prerequisites: Use the stated audience and synthetic task goal without adding unstated instructions.
Reviewers complete calibration examples before independent scoring.
Reset the journey and do not expose one reviewer's outcome to another reviewer.

steps.action: State the task goal and identify the next action using only the fixture wording.
steps.expected_observation: The reviewer can explain the goal and next action without guessing from external knowledge.
steps.evidence: Record a structured paraphrase and unclear terms.

steps.action: Trigger each synthetic error and attempt recovery using the presented guidance.
steps.expected_observation: The guidance identifies the problem and provides a usable correction path.
steps.evidence: Record the error, guidance, attempted correction and result.

steps.action: Repeat independently on the corrected fixture before comparing reviews.
steps.expected_observation: Differences are reported through agreement metrics without rewriting either independent result.
steps.evidence: Record both outcomes and any unresolved disagreement.

expected_observations: Task goal, next action, terminology and error recovery are separate judgements.
Ambiguous evidence is cannot-tell rather than forced into pass or fail.
stop_conditions: Stop if the reviewer needs information outside the public fixture and mark the step cannot-tell.
Stop after a blocking error prevents later steps and mark them not-tested.
Do not collect education, diagnosis or other participant profile data.
evidence_requirements: Audience statement, synthetic task goal and exact fixture revision.
Structured paraphrase and recovery trace.
Independent outcomes retained before disagreement review.

protocols.title: User-task completion review
prerequisites: Use a trained facilitator and the public synthetic checkout goal.
Obtain appropriate consent outside the published benchmark bundle and publish no participant data.
Verify the fixture cannot create a real purchase, account or external submission.

steps.action: Present the synthetic checkout goal without demonstrating the interface.
steps.expected_observation: The reviewer begins from the declared entry with only the task goal.
steps.evidence: Record facilitator prompt version and fixture entry.

steps.action: Observe progress through every declared step without redirecting unless a safety stop applies.
steps.expected_observation: Completion, blockers, recovery attempts and assistance are distinguishable.
steps.evidence: Record step outcomes and facilitator interventions without participant identifiers.

steps.action: Run the matched corrected journey as a separate session and retain both results.
steps.expected_observation: Task outcomes remain a user-task lane and are not merged into automated conformance metrics.
steps.evidence: Record separate completion status, assistance and not-tested steps.

expected_observations: Completion, assistance, abandonment and recovery are recorded without identity or profile data.
The result is scoped to the synthetic task, environment and review session.
stop_conditions: Stop immediately at a reviewer request or any sign of discomfort.
Stop if the fixture leaves the public synthetic host or requests real personal, payment or account data.
Stop before any irreversible action and mark remaining steps not-tested.
evidence_requirements: Pseudonymous reviewer ID, facilitator prompt version and exact environment.
Step outcome and assistance count without quotes or identifying recordings.
No participant data, production evidence or real transaction values.
